open_points.subject: record_change
open_points.text: record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] A StoredValue whose value_id already exists is not written again, since equal values share one identity. A StoredValue carries no bytes: the bytes of every StoredValue a change names MUST already be published under its value_digest by the caller with put_value_bytes before the change, as spooled files must already be published in the run's spool by spool_file before the change that writes their SpooledFile records; record_change publishes, rewrites and re-checks no value bytes and no spooled file, and writes only records.
open_points.rule: Класс выбирается по основной роли note, а не по продуктовой теме.
open_points.question: The pre-publication and no-file-access requirement must use [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] as its primary class; keep the existing-record assignment rule in a separate [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] note if both requirements are retained.
